text:
maria: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private page copy before we push to staging tomorrow morning. Can we iterate here? I pasted hero + CTAs I like.

sam: Hero options for Hosted API:
```1) "Ship LLM features faster — production-ready hosted inference with predictable latency and simple SDKs." 
2) "Hosted inference that scales with your app — low latency, transparent pricing." 
CTA: "Get API keys" / "See benchmarks"```

sam: For Dedicated:
```1) "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and enterprise controls." 
2) "Dedicated inference: predictable latency, isolated data, SLA-backed uptime." 
CTA: "Talk to sales" / "Request capacity"```

sam: For Private:
```1) "Private deployment: VPC or on‑prem inference with customer-managed keys." 
2) "Keep inference in your network — compliance-ready, auditable, enterprise support." 
CTA: "Contact enterprise" / "Request trial"```

jake: +1 on the tone. Small ask: on Dedicated copy, call out "SLA-backed" specifically (legal requires wording). Also include a short line about autoscaling policies — customers ask.

anya: Webinar CTA — can we reuse "See benchmarks" but route to the webinar signup for PLG users? For enterprise leads from Dedicated/Private pages, route to a HubSpot enterprise form (hidden field: lead_source=site_dedicated).

leo: Design constraints: hero must be <= 12 words. Also we need a 60-character meta description. Sam please make 1-line alt hero for each.

sam: Short variants:
Hosted alt: "Fast, hosted LLM inference — simple API, predictable latency."
Dedicated alt: "Reserved GPU capacity, guaranteed throughput."
Private alt: "On‑prem/VPC inference with enterprise controls."

maria: Love these. Quick decisions:
- Hosted: go with sam option 1, CTA "Get API keys" -> routes to self-serve signup. :rocket:
- Dedicated: use sam option 2 but add "autoscaling policies" in the bullets, CTA "Talk to sales" -> HubSpot enterprise form. :raised_hands:
- Private: use sam option 2, CTA "Contact enterprise" -> sales + security review track.

maria: Tasks — assign:
sam -> finalize hero alt + meta descriptions by EOD. 
leo -> produce hero art mockups for each variant by tomorrow AM.
anya -> wire up HubSpot form + hidden lead_source fields and confirm routing to sales slack channel.
jake -> confirm wording with legal for "SLA-backed" and autoscaling line.

jake: will confirm SLA wording. flagging one more thing — benchmarks link should have per-token cost table for Hosted vs Dedicated. Product has numbers?

maria: Product, can you drop a short bullet here with numbers we can show? Otherwise we show ranges and link to deep benchmark post.

jake: Quick numbers (approx): Hosted median p50 latency 80ms per token (gpt-xx style), cost $0.003/token for standard gen; Dedicated cost varies by commitment — show example: 30% lower unit cost at 1yr reserved on m40-equivalent. I'll add a note to the benchmarks doc.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — staging site lock from 06:00-08:00 UTC tomorrow. Schedule updates before or after window.

maria: Noted. Final ask — sam/leo can you drop final copy + 3 mockups into the shared drive and ping here when done? I'll sign off and schedule the staging push after legal ok. :eyes:

sam: will do, dropping links when ready.

leo: will upload mocks by 08:30 UTC.

anya: setting up form now, will confirm mapping.

jake: looping in legal. thanks.

maria: thanks team — short, focused. We'll ship the new pages + webinar CTA once legal confirms. :party_parrot:
